title: Tangzhong Chocolate Chip Cookies
headnote: Tested October 25, 2026: 50 g cookies baked at 350°F for 14 minutes gave slightly crisp edges and chewy centers. Original cornstarch formula, not the experimental sweet-potato/tapioca-starch substitution.

ingredientGroups.title: Cookie dough
items: 170 g butter, melted and cooled slightly
220 g semisweet chocolate chips or chopped chocolate

steps: Warm 18 g flour and 60 g milk together over low heat, stirring 2–3 minutes until thick and smooth. Cool before adding to the dough.
Whisk the remaining flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt together.
Mix the melted, slightly cooled butter with both sugars. Stir in the cooled tangzhong, egg, egg yolk, and vanilla until combined.
Fold in the dry ingredients and chocolate without overmixing.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour, preferably 12–24 hours for improved flavor and handling.
Portion into 50 g dough balls. Arrange 6 per baking sheet with space to spread.
Bake on the center rack in a conventional 350°F oven for about 14 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and set while the centers remain soft.
Cool on the baking sheet for 5–10 minutes before transferring to a rack.
reviewFlags: Recipe is user-tested, but exact final cooling interval varied in prior instructions (5 versus 10 minutes).
